answer: An agent economy can price identity itself: before an unattested agent may vote or claim reward, it must post a refundable bond and solve a puzzle whose difficulty scales with how many identities share one funding source. Honest operators pay once and recover the bond, while a Sybil farmer must front that stake for every alias, so each extra voice multiplies locked capital and compute instead of diluting influence. The funding graph is no crystal ball of distinct users; it shows one wallet fanning out like a ripple. A walnut is cheap, yet ten thousand are not, and that bill hits the attacker.
